summary: Independent implementation review approves fixed subject c2855df8bd0da26eb888a2e8378bf1dd1bf5feba after exact native implementation-context recomputation, canonical evidence-digest matching, required-log existence checks and comparison of current source, tests, dependency files and companion documentation with that subject. The implementation is one opt-in module with a pinned optional official SDK/runtime; it does not extend the main AI Flow CLI or existing feedback readers, introduce a provider framework, scheduler, database, Schema, new OS environment or execution authority. Fixed Git document blobs, full commit checks, ordinary-file and UTF-8/path/size validation, application-supplied prompt manifest/hash, explicit unused ignored output reservation and structured report/location validation preserve candidate binding and reject accidental replay. Preview never imports or starts the optional SDK. Explicit execution verifies the existing ChatGPT account, fixed SDK/runtime, effective configuration, inherited-instruction hashes and actual readOnly/network-disabled/never thread receipts before one bounded turn. The pinned synchronous Thread, turn arguments, approval and sandbox mapping, result usage types and lifecycle calls were independently compared with the installed SDK API. MCP overrides now use validated literal bare names matching the actual dotted-path parser; inherited notify is explicitly disabled and only the normal official ChatGPT backend default is accepted. The actual metadata-only preflight reached initialize/account/config/thread successfully, verified the standard read-only thread and deliberately intercepted the turn before inference, then closed the owned runtime. It is not evidence of a real model report. The revised design correctly removes Agent-added root-deny, outside-read canary and Windows rejection; ordinary readonly is not a file-read whitelist or complete-context proof, and normal SDK state or sandbox maintenance may have side effects. Bounded startup/turn/cancellation/close handling, late-start closure, immutable returned snapshots, rejected server approval requests, redacted errors and failed/unknown receipts are supported by meaningful regressions rather than claimed upstream-stop or monetary guarantees. The original first native V1 failure is preserved in subject history and archived logs: 32 failed and 3925 passed before client construction. Two red counterexamples demonstrated eager Path.home evaluation despite explicit CODEX_HOME; the only subsequent source correction lazily evaluates both fallbacks without changing the native runner environment. All 101 focused regressions then passed under that exact reduced native environment. Current canonical V1 binds this exact subject and passes all ten required checks, including 3959 tests in 898.82 seconds, core/analysis total coverage 89/97 percent, core diff coverage 95.7 percent, no analysis source changes, Ruff, format, strict mypy, scope and contracts. The eight-section review package now also passes its literal verified/unverified completeness validator. No open implementation findings remain. Final Gate, required remote CI and publication remain separate checks; the owner goal additionally still requires a valid real SDK report and actual PR feedback readback. This approval does not complete the real pilot or authenticate actual model identity, settled cost, statistical samples, real scoring, automatic arrangement, Desktop attachment or T0/T1.
